items.title: What's on This Page
items.why:
ChatGPT drew all 11 exercises. Some came in more than one version, because two of the images repeated moves. Each picture is the real exercise screen with that drawing in it. Nothing in the app has changed yet.

Pick one version for each move. I've marked the closest match to the brief, and I say what's off in each.

The ankle weights are drawn on both ankles, not only on the moving leg. I think that's fine; tell me if not. ChatGPT also drew a weighted vest push-up, which isn't in the app, so I left it out.
